ns2:course.label: Intermediate Hindi I
ns2:course.description: First term of second year of the Hindi language, including drill for more advanced conversational fluency; introduction to a greater variety of styles and levels of discourse and usage; and increasing study of the written language and more formal grammar. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HNDI 202 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HNDI 202 or equivalent.
